The '''super tactical droid''' was a model of [[Tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Super tactical droids often served as [[General/Legends|generals]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].

==Characteristics==
Super [[Tactical droid/Legends|tactical droids]] were created for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to address shortcomings in the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] and to serve [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] implicitly, much like most other droids in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] They stood 1.94 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and were programmed to resist interrogation.<ref name="TCW:Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the super tactical droid [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]] was sent to aid [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in quelling a [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|rebel uprising]] on his [[Planet/Legends|world]]. The droid seemed to dislike [[Human/Legends|Human]] tactics, seeing itself as superior to its flesh-and-[[Blood/Legends|blood]] counterparts. It focused only on the most likely attacks and refused to consider alternatives. It was overly suspicious of any display of pity for the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebellion]], and pursued cutthroat tactics that were often questioned and disregarded by its human counterpart, General [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]]. Following a rebel victory, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] ordered General Kalani to leave the planet, so Kalani [[Death/Legends|executed]] King Rash and retreated his forces to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="TCW:TP" />

Not too long after, another droid named [[Aut-O/Legends|Aut-O]] was commander of a small fleet of light destroyers and a [[Aut-O's flagship/Legends|dreadnought]]. He was [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|decapitated]] by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] when the droid fell on his head.<ref name="TCW:SW">{{TCW|Secret Weapons}}</ref> [[Unidentified super tactical droid (Carida)/Legends|Another]] super tactical droid was seen inside the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' that [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] took refuge in after [[Escape from Abafar/Legends|escaping]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].<ref name="TCW:PNR">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>

The tactical droid [[Kraken/Legends|Kraken]] was assigned to Admiral [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] at [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]]. After clone trooper [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] prematurely executed [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Trench was ordered by Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to capture him. Droid forces captured the clone, and Trench ordered Kraken to personally oversee the transfer. Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] boarded the shuttle and held Kraken for interrogation. When the droid refused to answer his question, Skywalker terminated him.<ref name="TCW:Unknown" /> Kraken was later rebuilt and partook in the [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|invasion of Scipio]]. Kraken and the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] retreated by order of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] due to the Separatists' plan invoking the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] being fulfilled. Some time after the battle, another tactical droid was onboard Dooku's command ship when he was contacted by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and ordered to travel to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Sacrifice">{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Super tactical droids first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five]].
